name: Mobile GlideForm (g_form)
title: Mobile GlideForm (g_form) - Client
summary: The Mobile GlideForm (g_form) API provides methods to work with forms on the mobile platform.
overview: Use these methods in any script that targets a mobile device.

members.name: MobileGlideForm
members.sig: MobileGlideForm (g_form) - addDecoration(String fieldName, String icon, String text)
members.summary: Adds a decorative icon next to a field.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
fieldName String The field name.
icon String The font icon to show next to the field.
text String The text title for the icon (used for screen readers).
Returns
Type Description
void

This example adds a VIP icon next to the caller.

function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
      // if the caller_id field is not present, then we can't add an icon anywhere
      if (!g_form.hasField('caller_id'))
          return;
      
      if (!newValue)
         return;
      
      g_form.getReference('caller_id', function(ref) {
      g_form.removeDecoration('caller_id', 'icon-star', 'VIP');
      
      if (ref.getValue('vip') == 'true')
           g_form.addDecoration('caller_id', 'icon-star', 'VIP');			
      });
      }

members.name: MobileGlideForm
members.summary: Determines if a field is present on the form.
members.html:
Present means that it can be shown, not that it is visible.

Parameters
Name Type Description
fieldName String The field to look for.
Returns
Type Description
Boolean True if the field is present on the form; false, if it is not. On the form means that the field is part of g_form. It could still be hidden, read-only, mandatory, or invalid.

This example makes the assigned_to field mandatory if the assignment_group field is on the form.

if (g_form.hasField('assignment_group'))
      g_form.setMandatory('assigned_to', true);

      if (!newValue)
           return;
      
      g_form.getReference('caller_id', function(ref) {
